name: Cheesy Portobello "Smash" Burger with Avocado, Sprouts & Romaine Salad
instructions: Place mayo, ketchup, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the special sauce and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, remove stems from portobello mushrooms. Place on a plate, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add mushrooms, cap-side down. Cook until starting to soften, about 3 minutes. Flip and continue to cook, occasionally pressing down with the bottom of a spatula, until golden underneath, 2-3 minutes more.
While the mushrooms are cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
When the mushrooms are golden underneath, flip once more and top with cheese. Continue to cook until cheese melts and mushrooms are fork-tender, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Slice two tomatoes crosswise into thin rounds; medium dice remaining tomatoes. Place slices on a clean plate and add diced tomato to the bowl with the lettuce and dressing; toss to combine the salad.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice lengthwise into thin slices. Add to the plate with the tomato.

Spread special sauce over the bottom half of each bun; top with cheesy portobellos, then layer with tomato, avocado, and sprouts. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
